title: Aditri1507/AI-Document-Chat-Assistant
summary: DocuMind AI 是一个基于 JavaScript 开发的文档问答助手，利用检索增强生成（RAG）技术，从上传的文档中提供上下文相关的答案，而非通用的 AI 响应。该应用支持用户上传文档并基于内容提问，适用于需要从大量文档中快速获取信息的场景。，基于模型推理的架构
description: DocuMind AI allows users to upload documents and ask questions based on the uploaded content. The application uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to provide contextual answers from document data instead of generic AI responses.
